composer.askQeetAiOr: Ask Qeet AI, or describe an action…

emptyState.intro: Ask about your tenant, look things up, or generate code — all under your own permissions. In this version the assistant reads and explains; it doesn't make changes.

prompts.newDevices: Show users who signed in from a new device this week
prompts.leastPrivilegeRole: Draft a least-privilege role for support engineers
prompts.simulateBilling: Simulate whether alice@acme.com can delete billing settings
prompts.terraformOidc: Generate Terraform for our production OIDC client

toolCallCard.nothingWasChangedThe: Nothing was changed. The assistant can't make changes in this version.
toolCallCard.secretNotice: {{label}} — shown once, never sent to the model. Store it securely now.

errors.failed: The action could not be completed.
errors.capabilityDenied: This action requires the "{{capability}}" capability, which is not granted to your account.
errors.invalidInput: The assistant sent input this action doesn't accept.
errors.timedOut: The action took too long and was stopped.
errors.unknownTool: The assistant asked for an action that doesn't exist.
errors.notEnabled: This action isn't available with your current permissions.

historyPanel.deleteBody: This permanently removes the conversation and its messages from this browser.

chat.turnFailed: The assistant could not complete this turn.

stream.conversationUnavailable: Could not open a conversation on the server.

unconfigured.notConnected: Qeet AI is ready, but no AI provider is connected for this organization yet.
unconfigured.onceConnected: Once an owner or admin adds an AI provider key under **Settings → Qeet AI** (or an operator sets a platform key on the Qeet ID server), I'll be able to:
unconfigured.answer: **Answer questions** about users, roles, policies, connections, and audit events in this tenant
unconfigured.act: **Run actions as tools** — create users, rotate signing keys, simulate authorization, search audit logs — always through your own permissions, with a confirmation step before anything destructive
unconfigured.lookUp: **Look things up** — search users and audit logs, simulate authorization — always through your own permissions, and explain where to make a change yourself
unconfigured.generate: **Generate** Terraform, SDK snippets, and API examples from your live configuration
unconfigured.audit: Everything I do runs under your access and is written to the audit log. Nothing here bypasses authorization.

labels.userAuditEvents: View audit events for this user

descriptions.searchUsers: Find users by name, email or status
descriptions.resetMfa: Force the user to re-enroll MFA at next sign-in
descriptions.userAuditEvents: Search the audit log filtered to this user
descriptions.simulateAccess: Test whether a user can perform an action

prompts.suspendedUsers: List all suspended users in this tenant.
prompts.userActivity: Summarize recent user activity and any anomalies in the audit log.
prompts.userRecentActivity: Summarize the most recent audit events for the currently selected user.
prompts.explainRoles: Explain the roles and their assigned permissions in plain English.
prompts.summarizePolicies: List and summarize the active ABAC policies for this tenant.
prompts.summarizeAnomalies: Summarize any unusual or high-risk events in the recent audit log.
prompts.failedLogins: Search the audit log for failed authentication events in the last 24 hours.
prompts.adminActions: List the most recent administrative actions by all operators in this tenant.
prompts.explainOAuth: Explain the OAuth 2.0 grant types available in Qeet ID and when to use each.
prompts.explainSecurity: Explain the current authentication policy and its security implications.

createUser.body: Qeet AI will create a new user account in this tenant.

updateUser.body: Qeet AI will change this user's profile.

disableUser.body: This will immediately block the user from signing in. They can be re-enabled later.

enableUser.body: This re-activates the user and restores their ability to sign in.

deleteUser.body: This will permanently soft-delete the user. This action cannot be easily reversed.

resetUserMfa.title: Reset MFA
resetUserMfa.body: This will clear all enrolled MFA factors. The user must re-enroll at their next sign-in.

createOrganization.body: Qeet AI will create a new organization (tenant).

createRole.body: Qeet AI will create a new role in this organization.

assignRole.title: Assign role
assignRole.body: This grants the role's permissions to the user — a privilege change.

grantPermission.body: This broadens what every user holding the role can do — a privilege change.

setStrictMfa.enforceBody: Every member will be required to complete MFA on each sign-in.
setStrictMfa.disableBody: This weakens tenant security: members will be able to skip MFA on trusted devices.

createOAuthClient.body: This registers a new OAuth/OIDC client. Confidential clients mint a client secret shown once.

rotateOAuthClientSecret.title: Rotate client secret
rotateOAuthClientSecret.body: The existing client secret will stop working immediately. Update your application before confirming. The new secret is shown once only.

rotateSigningKeys.body: Signing keys rotate by deployment, not from the console. Nothing will be changed.
